summary: Prerequisites for contributing to community.general: add ~/dev/ansible/collections/ to COLLECTIONS_PATHS and make sure no earlier path holds another copy of the collection.
questions: What collections path should I set before hacking on community.general?
Why is Ansible ignoring my local checkout of community.general?

answer_card.title: Collections path setup for contributing
answer_card.answer_md:
- Include `~/dev/ansible/collections/` in `COLLECTIONS_PATHS`.
- If several directories are listed, make sure none earlier in the search path contains another copy of `community.general`, or it will be loaded instead.
